content.text:
**What I'd tell my friend:** I didn't decide anything yet. I've got a shortlist, but I'm only half sure about it. Here's what decided it: the page has a "מאיפה להתחיל" bit near the top. It says "כסף שצריך להישאר זמין: קרן כספית", and I already have a "קרן השתלמות" through work. So the 30k probably gets split. Some goes into a קרן כספית so I can still get at it. For growth I'd look at the "מדד S&P 500" card, through a "חשבון ניירות ערך", which the page says can be at "בבנק". The page doesn't tell me how much any of this costs, and it doesn't tell me what to actually click first.

**How it went:**
- **Top of the page.** The heading "מדריך" says "כל סוג של חיסכון והשקעה שהאתר מכסה". That's exactly what I wanted, so I stayed.
- **"שני חלקים בכל חיסכון".** I read the first line. So there's where the money is kept and what it's invested in. Okay, sort of. The second line had "מק״מ, אג״ח" and I just skipped it.
- **"מאיפה להתחיל".** Three links. This was the most useful part of the whole page.
- **"איפה הכסף מוחזק".** I stopped on the headings only: "כסף שוטף וקצר", "חיסכון עם הטבת מס", "פרישה", "לילדים", "לבחירה עצמית".
  - In "לבחירה עצמית" I read the first line of the "חשבון ניירות ערך" card ("בבנק, בבית השקעות"), which is the place you buy stuff.
  - I didn't open "קופת גמל להשקעה". It sounds like a pension thing for older people.
  - I skipped "פרישה" and "לילדים" completely. Not for me.
- **"במה הכסף מושקע".** Looking at the headings, I found "מדד S&P 500", the thing everyone at work talks about. Its first line says "חמש מאות החברות הגדולות בארצות הברית", so that's the one.
  - Then there are like seven more indexes that all look the same: MSCI World, MSCI AC World, נאסד״ק 100, ת״א‑35, ת״א‑90, ת״א‑125. That's where I got lost. With that many options I'd rather just take the one I've heard of.
- **Footer.** I didn't read it.

**Words I didn't get:** "מק״מ", "אג״ח", "מזומן שקלי", "חשיפה לדולר או מנוטרלת ממנו", and the little buttons "יומית" and "מתחדשת" on the קרן כספית card. I also don't know if "קרן נאמנות" is the same thing as the ETF people talk about.

**What bothered me:**
- There isn't a single number on the page. No fees in shekels, no returns, nothing.
- It never says "do this first".
- The grey text on black is hard to read on my phone.
- "מקור" is a name I've never heard of.
- I'd have closed it around the wall of index cards.
